messages:
Jordan M (sales): Heads-up - POC kickoff with Ledgerly (payments startup). They want a lightweight POC: dev team on hosted keys, demo load ~15rps, and an option to spin up Dedicated for the final staging demo. Need an internal runbook/checklist so sales can move fast.
Riya K (solutions): I'll draft a runbook. Core ask: hosted API for dev, Dedicated reserve for staging, and later a VPC/private path. Any must-have security items?
Nadia S (security): Must include: customer-supplied KMS for Private, SOC2 link, encryption at rest, TLS, retained audit logs (default 30d), and a quick DPA pointer. Also verify if Ledgerly needs egress control.
Tom H (infra): For Dedicated sizing: at 15rps steady with bursts to 40rps, recommend 3 A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale min=2,max=5. We can enable prefix KV cache + batching to reduce sustained cost.
Jordan M (sales): Good. Can we make a checklist I can paste into the CRM? Need owner for each step and ETA before Wed demo.
Riya K (solutions): Draft checklist below — please review and edit.

```
POC Provisioning Runbook - Ledgerly
- Owner: Jordan M (sales)
- Timeline: provision by Tue 18:00 PT

1) Sales intake
  - Collect billing contact, primary dev email, desired region, and VPC details (if known)
  - Ask: will customer bring their KMS? (yes/no)

2) Hosted dev keys (short-lived)
  - Owner: Tom H
  - Command (ops):
    curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/api-keys \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"name":"ledgerly-poc-hosted","scopes":["generation:read"],"expires_at":"2025-07-01T00:00:00Z","rate_limit":60}'
  - Post: store key in 1Password shared vault and notify devs

3) Dedicated pool request
  - Owner: Tom H
  - Submit infra ticket with payload: model=redwood-open-70b-quant, gpus=3, region=us-west-2, autoscale:min=2,max=5, canary=80% dedicated->hosted fallback
  - ops-bot will return ticket ID. Track ETA and provisioning.

4) VPC/Private prep (if customer opts in)
  - Owner: Riya K
  - Ask customer for: VPC CIDR, allowed subnets, peering account ID, preferred KMS ARN, egress rules
  - Provide step-by-step network diagram and sample peering config

5) Security & compliance bundle
  - Owner: Nadia S
  - Deliverables: SOC2 link, DPA pointer text, audit logs retention info, encryption statements

6) Perf snapshot
  - Owner: Tom H
  - Provide latency numbers at 512 tokens and 2048 tokens on target infra (sample numbers acceptable)

7) Pricing & promos
  - Owner: Jordan M
  - Populate pricing sheet: reserved monthly price (3 GPU), short-term POC credit, and demo uplift rate

8) Post-demo cleanup
  - Revoke hosted keys, scale down Dedicated pool, and archive logs
```
Riya K (solutions): That's the first pass. Notes: add KV cache on Dedicated, and enable tracing for the demo route.
Tom H (infra): I'll open the infra ticket now. Expected turnaround for Dedicated in our region is ~18 hours.
ops-bot: infra-ticket created: INF-4332. Payload attached. Status: provision-scheduled.
Nadia S (security): Quick DPA pointer text (copyable): "Please execute our standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) available at https://redwood.ai/legal/dpa. For POCs we accept a short-term signature via email and will follow with formal agreement upon expansion."
Jordan M (sales): Nice. One last ask: Ledgerly wants a simple one-page diagram showing hosted vs Dedicated vs Private flow. Riya, can you add that to the bundle?
Riya K (solutions): Yep; I'll attach the diagram + SOC2 link to the outbound email. ETA: Mon noon.
Tom H (infra): Provisioning ETA: Tue 07:00 PT per ops schedule. Will post when pools are live and provide a small perf run.
Jordan M (sales): Thanks team. I'll update CRM with the checklist and owners, and follow up after I get the billing contact.
ops-bot: INF-4332 status: provisioned -> running. Give it ~10 minutes for model warmup.
Tom H (infra): Pool live. Quick perf: 70b-quant median 92ms/token @512 tokens, p95 ~160ms. KV cache shows 2.5x token cost reduction in synthetic repeat prompts.
Jordan M (sales): Perfect. Sending demo invite to Ledgerly now.
Nadia S (security): After demo, keep logs for 30 days and then archive unless customer asks otherwise.
Jordan M (sales): Closing loop. Thanks everyone :rocket:
